courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: When working with Ionic or when programming anything,
things don't always go as planned and in such cases, you need to know how to debug, how to find errors,
how to fix them and therefore in this module, I want to give you a brief overview of the different debugging
capabilities you have when working on an Ionic and especially an Ionic with Angular project, both in
the web as well as in the native apps you'll be building.
Therefore, we'll have a look at these two things,
